sources.entry: trax - Music library manager with audio conversion and tag editing. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/nbonamy/trax)

summary.one_liner: Trax is a macOS app for organizing, editing, and playing a local music library, built with Flutter.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you browse your music by artist and album or search across the whole library. You can import MP3, FLAC, and M4A files, either individually or as whole folders. Tags, artwork, and lyrics can be edited for single tracks or a selection of tracks. The app can find missing album years and flag inconsistent genres within an album, and it can convert audio between formats. Playback includes a floating player with shuffle and repeat.
use_cases: organize a local music library on a Mac
fix missing years and genres in album tags
edit song tags and album artwork in bulk
add or edit lyrics for tracks
convert MP3, FLAC, or M4A files to another audio format
play local music with shuffle and repeat
notable: Bulk tag, artwork, and lyrics editing for a selection of tracks
Detects missing album years and inconsistent album genres
Floating player window with shuffle and repeat
Imports whole folders of MP3, FLAC, and M4A files
caveats: macOS only, as the run command targets macOS
Setup requires a Flutter development environment; the README gives no packaged download
README does not state a license
